What are your thoughts on Mad Max?

Besides the graphics being top notch and running smooth as butter, the sound design is fantastic. Driving in your car sounds as good as it feels. I would say that the ground fighting can become repetitive, but there are different ways you can approach missions if you get tired of button mashing. Fighting is just like the Batman games if you played those, with mad max having his own weapons at his disposal. You spend a lot of time upgrading and battling against enemies with your car. Once I got used to it, I really had a lot of fun with this mechanic. I would just drive around aimlessly smashing the crap out of lone cars or finding convoys to destroy. Lots to enjoy really. A great weather system. Racing events. Upgrading. Scavenging. Fighting. WITNESS ME!

I really enjoyed the game and did not regret the purchase after completing it.

The world is fantastic! It somehow managed to make a baron, dead desert seem vibrant and intrigueing. The sound designs is really great with sand storms being heard from the distance and hearing cars and warboys from around the world drive around beeping their horns and shouting in the distance. The engine sounds are also brilliant, sounding heavy and rumbly. The whole world is created perfectly and really feels exactly as you would expect.

Now, story and missions.. If you've ever played a just cause game then you'll be on the right train of thought. It's very much a open world game, hundreds of items to collect and strongholds and ruins to go take over. The missions are very basic as they are for the most part just go here, get this. Kill these guys. Again though, if you've played and enjoyed any just cause games then you'd know that that doesn't really matter as the game play is fun and engaging. Cutscenes are created quite nicely even if they are pretty throwaway.

All in all, it's a fun game although very repetitive, plenty of collectibles and things to do and plenty of upgrades for your car and Max.
If you like the Arkham games, you'll enjoy Mad Max.
